lines.text: Hello again, and karibu! I'm Kwamboka.
lines.say: həlˈoʊ ɐɡˈɛn, ænd kɑːɾˈiːbuː! aɪm kwɑːmbˈɔːkɑː.

lines.text: This one is for you: mum, dad, or guardian.
lines.say: ðˈɪswˌʌn ɪz fɔːɹ juː: mˈʌm, dˈæd, ɔːɹ ɡˈɑːɹdiən.

lines.text: Let me show you how to follow your child's learning in Hatua.
lines.say: lˈɛt mˌiː ʃˈoʊ juː hˌaʊ tə fˈɑːloʊ jʊɹ tʃˈaɪldz lˈɜːnɪŋ ɪn hɑːtˈuːɑː.

lines.text: First, your child's class teacher gives you a small slip.
lines.say: fˈɜːst, jʊɹ tʃˈaɪldz klˈæs tˈiːtʃɚ ɡˈɪvz juː ɐ smˈɔːl slˈɪp.

lines.text: It has your parent number, and a one-time PIN.
lines.say: ɪt hɐz jʊɹ pˈɛɹənt nˈʌmbɚ, ænd ɐ wˈʌntˈaɪm pˈɪn.

lines.text: Hatua lives on the school's computer, so you'll use it at school.
lines.say: hɑːtˈuːɑː lˈaɪvz ɔnðə skˈuːlz kəmpjˈuːɾɚ, sˌoʊ juːl jˈuːz ɪɾ æt skˈuːl.

lines.text: On the sign-in page, choose: I am a parent.
lines.say: ɔnðə sˈaɪnɪn pˈeɪdʒ, tʃˈuːz: aɪɐm ɐ pˈɛɹənt.

lines.text: Type your parent number, and the PIN from your slip.
lines.say: tˈaɪp jʊɹ pˈɛɹənt nˈʌmbɚ, ænd ðə pˈɪn fɹʌm jʊɹ slˈɪp.

lines.text: Then press Sign in.
lines.say: ðˈɛn pɹˈɛs sˈaɪn ˈɪn.

lines.text: The first time, Hatua asks you to choose your own PIN.
lines.say: ðə fˈɜːst tˈaɪm, hɑːtˈuːɑː ˈæsks juː tə tʃˈuːz jʊɹ ˈoʊn pˈɪn.

lines.text: Pick one that only you know, and type it twice.
lines.say: pˈɪk wˈʌn ðæt ˈoʊnli juː nˈoʊ, ænd tˈaɪp ɪt twˈaɪs.

lines.text: From now on, that's your key.
lines.say: fɹʌm nˈaʊ ˈɔn, ðæts jʊɹ kˈiː.

lines.text: Next, Hatua shows you a short privacy notice.
lines.say: nˈɛkst, hɑːtˈuːɑː ʃˈoʊz juː ɐ ʃˈɔːɹt pɹˈaɪvəsi nˈoʊɾɪs.

lines.text: It says what you see, and how your child's information is kept.
lines.say: ɪt sˈɛz wʌt juː sˈiː, ænd hˌaʊ jʊɹ tʃˈaɪldz ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən ɪz kˈɛpt.

lines.text: Read it, tick the box, and press Agree and continue.
lines.say: ɹˈiːd ɪt, tˈɪk ðə bˈɑːks, ænd pɹˈɛs ɐɡɹˈiː ænd kəntˈɪnjuː.

lines.text: And here is your child's page.
lines.say: ænd hˈɪɹ ɪz jʊɹ tʃˈaɪldz pˈeɪdʒ.

lines.text: You can see the newest results in every learning area.
lines.say: juː kæn sˈiː ðə nˈuːɪst ɹɪzˈʌlts ɪn ˈɛvɹi lˈɜːnɪŋ ˈɛɹiə.

lines.text: Tap a level, if you'd like to see the record behind it.
lines.say: tˈæp ɐ lˈɛvəl, ɪf juːd lˈaɪk tə sˈiː ðə ɹˈɛkɚd bᵻhˈaɪnd ɪt.

scenes.title: Days in school, and the teacher's words

lines.text: You'll also find the days your child was in school.
lines.say: juːl ˈɔːlsoʊ fˈaɪnd ðə dˈeɪz jʊɹ tʃˈaɪld wʌz ɪn skˈuːl.

lines.text: And here is the comment from the class teacher.
lines.say: ænd hˈɪɹ ɪz ðə kˈɑːmɛnt fɹʌmðə klˈæs tˈiːtʃɚ.

lines.text: You only ever see your own child. Nobody else's.
lines.say: juː ˈoʊnli ˈɛvɚ sˈiː jʊɹ ˈoʊn tʃˈaɪld. nˈoʊbɑːdi ˈɛlsᵻz.

lines.text: Want to talk to the class teacher? Press Message the teacher on WhatsApp.
lines.say: wˈɔnt tə tˈɔːk tə ðə klˈæs tˈiːtʃɚ? pɹˈɛs mˈɛsɪdʒ ðə tˈiːtʃɚɹ ˌɔn wʌts ˈæp.

lines.text: Write your message. Hatua can make it shorter or warmer, if you like.
lines.say: ɹˈaɪt jʊɹ mˈɛsɪdʒ. hɑːtˈuːɑː kæn mˌeɪk ɪt ʃˈɔːɹɾɚ ɔːɹ wˈɔːɹmɚ, ɪf juː lˈaɪk.

lines.text: Check the teacher's name, tick the box, and press Send on WhatsApp.
lines.say: tʃˈɛk ðə tˈiːtʃɚz nˈeɪm, tˈɪk ðə bˈɑːks, ænd pɹˈɛs sˈɛnd ˌɔn wʌts ˈæp.

lines.text: WhatsApp opens with it ready, and you press Send there.
lines.say: wˌʌts ˈæp ˈoʊpənz wɪð ɪt ɹˈɛdi, ænd juː pɹˈɛs sˈɛnd ðˈɛɹ.

lines.text: What about senior school pathways?
lines.say: wˌʌt ɐbˌaʊt sˈiːnjɚ skˈuːl pˈæθweɪz?

lines.text: You'll see those ideas only after the teacher has talked them through with you, and opened them.
lines.say: juːl sˈiː ðoʊz aɪdˈiəz ˈoʊnli ˈæftɚ ðə tˈiːtʃɚ hɐz tˈɔːkt ðˌɛm θɹˈuː wɪð juː, ænd ˈoʊpənd ðˌɛm.

lines.text: You can also ask the Hatua assistant.
lines.say: juː kæn ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈæsk ðə hɑːtˈuːɑː ɐsˈɪstənt.

lines.text: Try something like: how is my child doing in Mathematics?
lines.say: tɹˈaɪ sˈʌmθɪŋ lˈaɪk: hˌaʊ ɪz maɪ tʃˈaɪld dˌuːɪŋ ɪn mˌæθɪmˈæɾɪks?

lines.text: It answers from the school's records, and it never compares children.
lines.say: ɪɾ ˈænsɚz fɹʌmðə skˈuːlz ɹˈɛkɚdz, ænd ɪt nˈɛvɚ kəmpˈɛɹz tʃˈɪldɹən.

lines.text: Then it suggests a next step, like sending the teacher a message.
lines.say: ðˈɛn ɪt sədʒˈɛsts ɐ nˈɛkst stˈɛp, lˈaɪk sˈɛndɪŋ ðə tˈiːtʃɚɹ ɐ mˈɛsɪdʒ.

lines.text: When you're done, always press Sign out.
lines.say: wˌɛn jʊɹ dˈʌn, ˈɔːlweɪz pɹˈɛs sˈaɪn ˈaʊt.

lines.text: Other families use this computer, too.
lines.say: ˈʌðɚ fˈæmɪliz jˈuːs ðɪs kəmpjˈuːɾɚ, tˈuː.

scenes.title: That is all

lines.text: That's all you need.
lines.say: ðæts ˈɔːl juː nˈiːd.

lines.text: You and the teacher, working together, step by step.
lines.say: juː ænd ðə tˈiːtʃɚ, wˈɜːkɪŋ təɡˈɛðɚ, stˈɛp baɪ stˈɛp.

lines.text: Asante sana!
lines.say: ɑːsˈɑːntɛ sˈɑːnɑː!

scenes.sub: You and the teacher, working together
